cards.title: Why the loop reads two things
items: The screenshot carries what a person would see; the accessibility tree carries what is actually there, including the ids a test can target
Reading both is what lets a recipe be written against a real screen rather than against a guess about one
The loop runs on a physical device over ADB, so what it verifies is the hardware path, not a simulator's approximation of it

cards.title: Two engines, chosen by the goal
items: Flash is a reactive loop at roughly 3 to 5 seconds per step, for smoke tests and button and tab checks
Pro adds a Planner, Operator and Checker with checkpoint audits, for multi-branch flows and crash investigation
Either way the run asserts zero FATAL crashes in the PixelKit packages, so a silent native failure fails the test
